name: xneelo Helper
author: xneelo

sections.description:
Installing the xneelo Helper Plugin simplifies the management of xneelo Cache for all WordPress users, including bloggers, small businesses, and resellers managing multiple sites. This plugin allows you to maximise the benefits of xneelo’s Cache feature, eliminating the need for manual cache clearing, reducing page load times, and ensuring that your website content remains up to date.

With this plugin, you can:

  • Automatically clear your cache every time you update or publish a post. This keeps your site fast and ensures visitors see the latest content.
  • Clear cache for a single page or your entire site without leaving WordPress – with just one click
  • Compatible with WP Rocket to ensure maximum website speed and performance.

Requirements

  • Pretty Permalinks enabled
  • Active xneelo Cache
sections.installation:
Install Through WP-Admin

  1. Navigate to the Plugins menu and click “Add New”.
  2. Search for “xneelo Helper”.
  3. Click “Install Now” on the xneelo Helper.

Automatic Install

  1. Download the zip file.
  2. Upload the zip file to the add plugins page in WP-Admin.

Manual Install

  1. Download the zip file.
  2. Extract the zip file into the wp-contents/plugins.
sections.faq:
Must I be hosted with xneelo to use this plugin?

Yes, this plugin provides the ability to purge xneelo Cache, which is only available when your site is hosted with xneelo

What is xneelo Cache

You can find more helpful information on xneelo Cache here.
